name: Lovers & Assassins: Taming the Shadows
source:
It's your final task as an apprentice assassin. Your real life begins on the other side of this mission. Will you complete the graduation kill – or die trying?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
这是你作为见习刺客的最后任务。你的真实生活从这个任务的另一边开始。你会完成毕业杀戮——还是在尝试中死去？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
